findings.title: 500 ms removal SLA remains unproved
findings.detail: The test proves delete follows a manually completed send, not that deletion occurs within 500 ms of webhook receipt. Resolve the conflict between confirmed-delivery-first and the receipt-relative deadline, then assert the selected contract with elapsed-time coverage.

findings.title: Embedded tk/mk negatives are missing
findings.detail: Current incidental-letter fixtures contain neither contiguous token. Add larger-word fixtures such as notksecret and somkvalue so an unbounded /tk|mk/ regression fails.

findings.title: Coder-final verification evidence is absent
findings.detail: The plan has both exact commands and the 8-file/71-test PASS summary, but the separately required coder final message is unavailable. Relay or persist that final output before accepting the green-suite claim.
